title.narrative: Women's Rights in Law and in Action: A Strengthened Feminist Movement against Gender Inequalities in Jordan

description.narrative: The Impact of the action will be to `Contribute towards the promotion and protection of women¿s economic and social rights in Jordan¿. In 2017, Only 17 percent of Jordanian women were economically active (seeking work, whether employed or unemployed), compared with 59 percent of men. Social norms that favour men as the sole breadwinners and impose restrictions on gender mixing, the absence of internal policies that prevent discrimination within institutions, the lack of regulations governing flexible work, part-time jobs, and decent working conditions, poor public transportation systems gender-based wage inequalities, and sexual harassment are significant obstacles to women's economic participation.
